buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Addl. Terms and Condition: 1. Bidder should quote latest product with respect to Market along with proper brochure.

2. EMD as specified in rule 170 of GFR 2017 issued by bank before opening of technical bid date & valid for 45 days beyond final bid validity period is Mandatory & be submitted Offline b efore opening of technical bid, EMD not received before opening of technical bid bidder will no t be considered to participate. 3. Bidder will have to deposit the sample of Quoted product at IG Central Frontier HQ, ITBP, Bhopal (M.P). for the verification of Product technical specifications at the time of technical bi d opening. without sample of quoted equipment, bidder will not be considered for technical b id process. 4. Bidder to submit OWN & OEM CA Certified TURNOVER CERTIFICATE & Net worth certificate with Sign and Stamp of last three years. 5. The bidder must submit an undertaking that they have Not Been Black Listed /Debarred on GEM by a ny state govt./ central govt./PSU in last 3 years as on last date of bid submission. 6. The bidder must submit anti-cartelization certificate. 7. Bidder/Firm/OEM will submit Land border under taking certificate as per Govt of India notification No. F.7/10/2021-PPD Dtd-23-02-2023. 8. Make in India (MII) Certificate is must to be uploaded on OEM letter head with stamp and signature. 9. The Product service centre with valid address with name & contact number is must in each consigne e city. 10. Bidder should have its Own & OEM Escalation Matrix and Dedicated Toll-Free Number. 11. The bidder must submit their valid PAN, GST Registration, ISO 9001 certificate. 12. Bidder to submit undertaking showing line by line compliance for the quoted product with specification on OEM letter head mentioning Bid number. 13. A GeM seller should have acquired rating 4.0 and above on the GeM platform. 14. For experience criteria , bidder must upload copies of contract on GeM to claim relevant experience. 15. Bidder must upload OEM PRODUCT CATALOGUE. 16. Apart from ATC, all Bidder will also Certify that they have fully understood about specifica tions / quantity of bid item and multiple consignee locations and agree to comply. 17. Technical compliance be submitted clearly mentioning bid number on OEM letterhead duly signed by authorized person. 18. 12v 65AH & 12v 100AH Battery Warranty should be Minimum 2 years 19. Preference will be given to MII/MSE sellers as per laid down rule position on GeM. .
